page.layout: One printed page. Running head at top centre with page number at top right. main_text.l: Abarhilt, Aberhilt. | Adalpirin. | Adaldiu, Adaldiuu, Adaldhiu.

page.notes: Three-column index with names in parallel columns; the two-column arrangement of the index and the letter-group divisions Y and Z were transcribed in row order. Some lines are split across columns (Vu., Vualdiricus, Vuaraffo) and some heavy printing in the margins. Several readings are uncertain due to scan quality, particularly the initial capitals (V/U) and words such as Vucrinharius and Vuiteratus; marked where doubtful is not applied as no [?] could be certainly assigned. Caput number given as 3.
